text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While training off-campus together with 
Admire Groove—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's all for today's training... Could 
you please head back ahead of me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She starts walking off somewhere just like 
that. What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, and here I wondered why she 
took off running so suddenly! She saw her 
beloved Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hello... Um... could those little ones 
with you be...

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Maruru's children♪ This girl is 
actually a mother, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Even in front of children, you're 
as restless as ever.

text_block_list.name: Maruru's Children
text_block_list.text: Yip, yip! Whine~! Sniff, sniff, sniff...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—when I met up with Admire Groove 
again, she had a somewhat dreamy look 
about her.
